skip_reason: Not a sales call. This is a post-move service-recovery and damage-claim negotiation on a completed two-day, ~$12,000 job. The branch manager called an already-moved customer who was escalating about being sent short-handed crews, a truck breaking down, items left behind, and over $2,000 in damage. The entire call is refund and claims resolution — Chris settles on refunding the full tip amount (~$1,829.55) plus getting the No Worries coverage extended from $2,000 to $2,500, and hands the damage process back to the customer experience team. There is no quote, no pricing pitch, no booking, and no prospective move discussed, so the 85-point sales scorecard does not apply. Routes to claims/CX review, not sales grading.
